d:
Kazakh Grandmaster Alisher Suleymenov is one of the players fighting it out at the Chola Chess 1st International GM Open 2026. He defeated Magnus Carlsen in a famous game in Qatar Masters 2023, and has played Gukesh and Sindarov multiple times! In this interview before the event, we speak with Alisher about his expectations from the tournament, his own preparation, thoughts on the World Championship match, mentality going into a tournament, a whole lot more.
Video: ChessBase India
Interview: Devansh Singh
Edited by: Himank Ghosh
